notes: Killing enemies, levelling to 5000, rising stats, level-gated gear and unlockable areas is the RPG progression loop end to end, so RPG leads alone — the swords and bosses are that loop's combat rather than a separate arena genre. Shape is world-open-biomes because the author asked for a few large regions with different landscapes whose access is gated by level, which is difficulty scaling with distance; I kept the Action RPG preset for its real-time combat and safe-town economy but swapped its world-hub-dungeon shape, since no dungeons or instances were ever mentioned, and added gate-progression for the stated area unlocks. The author said the regions are connected and called it an open world, so I overrode the shape's P4 and build it as one continuous surface, and took terrain-relief for the requested hills and nature, which puts tiered elevation on the route. Deciding without a user: the shop, inventory, settings menus, the 100 swords, 150 armors, 5000 levels and UI sizing are mechanics and interface rather than layout, so the town carries only the social-hub cluster where those are accessed.
